newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures dip again late, most end weaker.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures dip again late, most end weaker.

text.p: Sept 5 - U.S. debt futures dipped again late, most ended weak. Traders construed comments by Fed governor Yellen as slightly bearish but said market more focused on position squaring before Friday's Aug US jobs data. Yellen said price stability close, not yet acheived, that economy has small amount slack. Nonfarm payrolls seen up 244,000, 5.3-pct jobless rate. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
